description: Habit ownership check compares userIds case-insensitively, so a user whose id differs only by letter case can log completions on another user's habit.
Habit name length limit is counted in code points instead of UTF-16 units/bytes, so names up to roughly twice the intended 200 limit are accepted.
Day index uses truncation toward zero instead of floor, so timestamps before 1970-01-01 map to the wrong UTC day.
The href allowlist only checks that '#/' appears somewhere in the value rather than at the start, so a javascript: URL containing '#/' passes validation and can be set as a link.
Only 5xx responses are treated as failures, so 4xx responses other than 404 (e.g. 400) are parsed as success and replace the habit in client state with an undefined value.
When the body cap is exceeded the data/end/error listeners are not removed, so they stay attached to the request for the remainder of the oversized upload.
